snippet.title: Twilight Memoria: Freedom | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Two lives. Two fates. One chance to break free.
Wishlist Twilight Memoria: Freedom now ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440010/Twilight_Memoria__Freedom/ 

A story-rich turn-based JRPG about trust, resilience, and the fight for freedom.

🎭 Two women from different worlds, bound by fate
🛡️ Strategic turn-based combat with combo-driven team attacks
⚔️ Customize every class with flexible main + sub-specialties
🔮 Unlock powerful passives with Orb enhancements
👣 No random encounters — explore on your terms

From @ysysoftworks the creators of Twilight Memoria: Sun and Moon, comes a bold new standalone tale where every decision shapes your journey.

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
